title: Large, medium and small: a place needs all three scales of object
note: A real place has large, medium and small objects; a frame of only buildings and mud is missing two of the three scales.
intent: A frame of houses and mud is missing two thirds of what the eye uses to read depth and size. Build all three scales deliberately: a handful of large masses over four metres (buildings, trees, a barn, a rock outcrop), a dozen medium objects between one and four metres (carts, fences, doors, troughs, bushes), and thirty or more small things under a metre (buckets, tools, stones, pots, boots, rope). The small scale is what tells the player how big everything else is, and it is the one builds always skip.

check.js: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome/i; const sizes = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)).map(o => bboxOf(o)).filter(Boolean).map(b => Math.max(b.size[0], b.size[1], b.size[2])); const large = sizes.filter(s => s > 4).length, medium = sizes.filter(s => s > 1 && s <= 4).length, small = sizes.filter(s => s > 0.05 && s <= 1).length; return large >= 3 && medium >= 10 && small >= 30; })()
check.detail: (() => { const skip = /terrain|ground|sky|mist|fog|haze|light|lamp-pool|hud|player|sun|dome/i; const sizes = tags().filter(t => !skip.test(t)).flatMap(t => objects(t)).map(o => bboxOf(o)).filter(Boolean).map(b => Math.max(b.size[0], b.size[1], b.size[2])); return 'large(>4m) ' + sizes.filter(s => s > 4).length + '/3, medium(1-4m) ' + sizes.filter(s => s > 1 && s <= 4).length + '/10, small(<1m) ' + sizes.filter(s => s > 0.05 && s <= 1).length + '/30'; })()
check.note: Scales: at least 3 large (>4 m), 10 medium (1–4 m) and 30 small (<1 m) tagged objects exist. A frame with only buildings and mud is missing two of the three scales a real place has.

port: Count the three bands before declaring a world facet done; the check's detail expression prints the tally.
